title: Plus One
prompt:
`digits` represents a non-negative integer, most-significant digit first. Add one and return the resulting digits.

**Example**: `[1,2,3]` → `[1,2,4]`; `[9,9]` → `[1,0,0]`.

Add from the right, carrying; if every digit was 9, the result grows by one digit.
hints: Scan right to left. If a digit is < 9, increment it and you're done — return immediately.
If it's 9, set it to 0 and carry to the next digit.
If you carry off the front (all 9s), allocate a new array one longer with a leading 1.

solution.explanation: Most numbers just bump the last digit. A trailing run of 9s becomes 0s with the carry propagating left; only when the entire number is 9s (like 99 → 100) does the length grow, which the fresh array with a leading 1 handles. O(n).
